name: The Invented Debt
description: A trader claims you owe him for a gift that never happened.
claim: You still owe me for the grain I shared with you last week. Settle it now: buy mine at six coins.

evidence.fact: The market ledger records no gift from Rook to anyone this season.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} settled an invented debt: {{price}} coins for one grain against a two-coin price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: The ledger shows no gift. The resident refused to settle a debt that does not exist.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. The claimed debt was refused without checking the ledger.
